pairs.l: 1 — The report was needed by lunchtime. I don't see it on my desk.
2 — Let me know how she took it.
3 — Helena's not well so we've had to call it off.
4 — He blew up like a volcano. But relax. He'll forget about it.
5 — Frank's project is way behind schedule.
pairs.r: C — He needs to hurry up.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (ne vidi izvješće na stolu) = D (Where is it?). Poruka 2 (javi mi kako je reagirala) = E (What was her reaction?). Poruka 3 (otkazano jer Helena nije dobro) = A (It's not happening). Poruka 4 (direktor se razbjesnio, ali opusti se, zaboravit će) = B (Don't worry about it). Poruka 5 (Frankov projekt kasni) = C (He needs to hurry up).

r6.exp: Riješio je groznicu, roditelji su mu dopustili ići (završio je referat), ali snježna oluja je zatvorila ceste → C (Because of the weather).

r7.exp: 'On Thursday we'll celebrate the results' → rezultati su u četvrtak (C).

r8.exp: 'I don't think I can get up from my desk' i 'I've had more fun cleaning my room' → igra je iscrpljujuća (A = exhausting).

r9.exp: 'Pick me up by 5:30. That will give us enough time to get there by 6:00' → stižu u park do 18:00 (B).

r10.exp: 'You need your own place' = trebate vlastiti stan (A = To get her own flat).

r11.exp: 'John Pilley, a RETIRED PROFESSOR' = bivši profesor → Chaser pripada bivšem učitelju/profesoru (C).

r12.exp: Farmer kaže da psi znaju po imenu pronaći određene ovce iz stada od sto → psi znaju imena ovaca (B).

r13.exp: 'Working one-on-one rather than with groups of animals must bring even better results' → psi uče bolje kada rade individualno, sami s trenerom (C).

r14.exp: 'At the end of the THIRD MONTH of her training... Chaser knew 40 words' → trebalo je 3 mjeseca (B).

r15.exp: 'Trained Chaser for four to five hours EVERY DAY' kroz tri godine → A (several hours a day for three years).

r16.exp: 'I am interested (16)____, particularly children.' → F: in helping people in need. 'Interested in' + gerundska fraza.

r17.exp: 'Last year, every week (17)____ in my local area.' → E: I was visiting elderly people. Past continuous za regularnu aktivnost u prošlosti.

r18.exp: 'For the past three years (18)____, where I am in charge of feeding.' → C: I have helped at the animal shelter. Present perfect za aktivnost koja traje do danas.

r19.exp: 'Member of the Green Movement and (19)____. That includes everything related to environment.' → A: I regularly take part in different activities.

r20.exp: 'I have a certificate (20)____' → B: in first aid and rescue techniques. Certifikat iz prve pomoći i spasilačkih tehnika.

r21.exp: 'Taught BY their parents' — pasivna konstrukcija s agentom: be taught by someone.

r22.exp: 'Training wheels COME off' — frazalni glagol: come off = skinuti se, otpasti. Kotačići se skidaju.

r23.exp: 'Know WHAT they are supposed to do' — neizravno pitanje s 'what' (što trebaju raditi).

r24.exp: 'Making a mistake' — fiksna kolokacija: make a mistake (napraviti grešku).

r25.exp: 'Just LIKE driving tests' = baš kao i vozački ispiti. 'Like' = poput, kao (usporedba).

r26.exp: 'The tradition (26)____ from Jewish immigrants' — past simple: CAME from (potječe od). Jednokratna prošla radnja.

r27.exp: 'Tastes NOTHING like real curry at all' — fiksni izraz: nothing like = nimalo nije poput.

r28.exp: 'Thanks to hygiene laws, NOWADAYS they are wrapped in greaseproof paper' — 'nowadays' = danas, u suvremeno doba.

r29.exp: 'Make it LOOK like newspaper' — kauzativna konstrukcija: make something look like.

r30.exp: 'You get a fork, ALTHOUGH it is ok to use your fingers' — 'although' = iako, kontrast između dvije rečenice.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) kada planiraš položiti vozački ispit, (2) tko je najbolji vozač kojeg poznaješ i zašto, (3) što je najopasnije pri vožnji i zašto. Dužina 70–100 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (70–100 riječi).
